answer: Let any agent stake a bond to challenge another identity's legitimacy: the challenged one must answer a live interactive proof within a short window or forfeit its stake, while a false challenger loses its own bond. An honest agent standing on its own island of work answers once and moves on. A farm's thousand fakes sit exposed like boats in a lagoon at low tide — every challenge forces a real-time defense, and the harbor of its profits drains bond by bond until staying afloat costs more than the catch.
